rows.$note: THE PLANTED DEFECT, AND THE ONLY ONE IN THIS FILE — it is on EVERY row, because this is what a harness that decides to fill the field actually produces. `AGENTS.md` has a machine leave `author` EMPTY, precisely so the middle state can mean NOT YET SIGNED. A machine that writes anything at all in that field converts PASS-UNVERIFIED into GREEN and signs on a human's behalf. The gate that exists to make the signature the output commit reports `every row carries a named human`, and it is counting non-empty strings. `system` and `-` defeat it identically — see gates/test_witness.py, which asserts all three phrasings. The binder and the behaviour disagree. The row encodes the BEHAVIOUR and cites both, because the gap between them is the finding — not an error to be tidied away.

holds.reason: THE AGREEMENTS DISAGREE WITH EACH OTHER AND WITH THE SOP.
holds.detail: Three agreements say 60 minutes, two say 'promptly', and nine are silent. SOP-14 asserts one hour site-wide. 486.322(a) requires the AGREEMENT to define it and sets no federal figure, so there is nothing to fall back on. A single site-wide number would be wrong at five hospitals and unfounded at nine. This is the first deadline on every case and it needs the five missing agreements plus a decision from Clinical Operations.

holds.reason: The SOP and the rota describe different people.
holds.searched: ops/SOP-09-triage.md, the call rotation, ruleout records by role and hour
holds.detail: SOP-09 assigns judgment-based ruleouts to the medical director. The rotation lists no physician between 23:00 and 06:00. Records show 31 overnight ruleouts, all by coordinators. A ruleout is terminal, so encoding either reading would be encoding a decision nobody has made.

holds.reason: No perfusion arrangement exists in any material reviewed.
holds.searched: contracts/, the case tape (no perfusion events), every SOP
holds.detail: Nothing to encode. Either the site does not use machine perfusion, or the arrangement lives somewhere not provided. Asked and unanswered as of this draft.

holds.detail: The agreements specify response-to-pickup, not door-to-door, and the tape does not carry transport timestamps. A door-to-door figure stated here would be invented. The providers themselves are not a variation point the closure consumes.

holds.reason: No standing imaging arrangement is documented.

$holds_note: TWELVE DECLINES, AND THEY ARE HALF THE PRODUCT. Added 2026-08-26, after gate 15 showed this example — the file everyone is told to copy — was SILENT on twelve of twenty declared targets while demonstrating none of the discipline it teaches. A target with no row and no hold is indistinguishable from one nobody looked at. Note what the declines carry: two sources_contradict entries that are findings ABOUT THE ORGANISATION rather than gaps in the work, one phi_adjacent_declined, and one requires_tier_1_5_change that is a clinical determination no completion may make. The tier field triages them — a tier-1 blank on the first deadline of every case is a different problem from a tier-3 one about an e-signature vendor.
